ruleDefinitions.name: Launch-VsDevShell.PS1 Proxy Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the 'Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' Microsoft signed script to execute commands.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*Launch\\-VsDevShell\\\.ps1.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*VsWherePath\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*VsInstallationPath\\ .*")))
